No explanation is given of the original inhabitants' fate nor whether it was Nick's Great Khans that were ultimately responsible. Nick's group in Novac was decimated by [[the Ghoul]], though Nick managed to survive. However, he was later captured by [[Hank MacLean]] and brainwashed into a loyal [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] [[X-Branch office worker|office worker]] at the [[Las Vegas management Vault]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Innovator]]=== During their journey through the Mojave, [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] arrive in Novac and discover the occupying Khans. '''Dr. "Nose" Edmundson''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Dr. Edmundson is the resident clinician of [[Vault 4]]. His nickname appears to derived from his prominent mutation, a second nose on his forehead.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Dr. Edmundson extracts a tooth out of [[Maximus]]'s right arm, comments on the surface's ingenuity of ammo use, and informs [[Powell|Nurse Powell]] that they will need an antibiotic for him. He then closes Maximus's wound with a staple gun, and after bandaging his wound, Dr. Edmundson uses his [[Pip-Boy]] and leaves Maximus.

Afterward, he's seen at a picnic table taking off his shower cap and Lucy becomes bewildered after she notices the extra nose on his forehead. Dr. Edmundson would see Lucy looking at him and would smile at her and nod assuredly.

Later, when Lucy infiltrates Level 12 of Vault 4, Dr. Edmundson is seen checking on the subjects inside their cryo-stasis pods. He also noted his worry that one of them may have escaped when he saw the door there as open. '''Old Woman Gretch''' is a wastelander who appears in the first episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
Gretch is an elderly woman running a small food stand in the post-War [[Mojave Wasteland]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Innovator]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] encounter her while chasing Lucy's father. Lucy buys and eats [[flea soup]] from her and inquires about the whereabouts of her father, [[Hank MacLean|Hank]]. Gretch reveals that Hank recently passed this way and took [[Sunburned man|her son]] with him, apparently forced or hired as a guide through the wasteland. Gretch isn't too sad because of the separation, but because her son owed her money, and now she will not get it. Lucy and Ghoul later find this son in [[Vault 24]]: he is already under control— a [[Brain-computer interface chip|brain chip]] has been inserted into his neck. Hank left him as a "messenger" with a message for Lucy, but the boy's head ends up exploding.
